findings.title: Local SQLite database is plaintext by default
findings.evidence: DatabaseEncryptionService.swift exists but GRDB-SQLCipher codec is not enabled; docs/THREAT_MODEL.md admits SQLCipher not yet vendored.
findings.impact: Any same-user process or filesystem access can read all agent logs, provider tokens, and usage data.
acceptance_criteria: PRAGMA cipher_version returns a version in Release builds.
DatabaseEncryptionService derives a unique key per install and stores it in the keychain.
Migration path documented for existing plaintext databases.

findings.title: App and daemon run unsandboxed
findings.evidence: README and docs/THREAT_MODEL.md explicitly state the app requires full home-directory access and cannot be sandboxed.
findings.impact: A compromised app or daemon has full access to the user's home directory, keychain, and can act as the user.
acceptance_criteria: Documented as accepted risk with compensating controls.
Daemon RPC enforces least privilege per method.

findings.title: Computer Use adversarial test coverage incomplete
findings.evidence: AgentLens/Services/ComputerUse/ has approval UI and kill switches, but AgentLensTests/Active/ lacks adversarial tests.
findings.impact: Attacker or malicious prompt could bypass approval, escalate scope, or trick user into approving harmful actions.
acceptance_criteria: Tests for all 13 tool kinds under adversarial input.
Tests for Trusted -> Step downgrade and panic kill.
Tests for cross-origin/cross-app injection in browser tool.

findings.title: Prompt / RAG injection defenses partial
findings.evidence: docs/security/LLM_GENAI_AGENT_THREAT_MODEL.md documents threat; delimiter wrappers exist but coverage not uniform.
findings.impact: Malicious agent log content can manipulate LLM output, leak data, or trigger unauthorized tool calls.
acceptance_criteria: Uniform untrusted-content wrapper at every ingestion -> prompt boundary.
Provenance metadata attached to RAG snippets.
Adversarial test corpus committed and run in CI.

findings.title: App Check production enforcement unverifiable
findings.evidence: functions/src/auth.ts has assertAppCheck but enforcement depends on Firebase console; Firestore rules lack request.app checks.
findings.impact: If App Check disabled/misconfigured, any client with stolen Firebase Auth token can read/write owner-scoped data via REST.
acceptance_criteria: Production console audit confirms App Check enforcement for Firestore.
Add repo-level assertion test that fails on rule drift.
Add runtime probe using non-attested token.

findings.title: Cloud sync metadata leaks provider/cost/device info
findings.evidence: Firestore usage/, usage_rollups/, quota_snapshots/ contain provider IDs, costs, timestamps, device IDs.
findings.impact: BurnBar/Firebase can profile user behavior; legal risk if marketing claims total privacy.
acceptance_criteria: Privacy policy accurately describes visible metadata.
Consider encrypting/hashing provider IDs and costs with user key.

findings.title: Daemon RPC lacks per-method capability isolation
findings.evidence: Daemon uses a single auth token; no documented authorization matrix.
findings.impact: Any client with the token can call any method, including Computer Use tool dispatch.
acceptance_criteria: Document RPC method authorization matrix.
Add per-method capability checks.
Consider per-client ephemeral tokens.

findings.title: Local MCP server exposes raw search snippets
findings.evidence: tools/openburnbar-mcp/server.py returns semantic-search snippets without human gate.
findings.impact: External AI agent with MCP access can exfiltrate sensitive user context.
acceptance_criteria: Add user approval before returning snippets.
Scope returned snippets to explicit query intent.
Add audit log of MCP tool calls.

findings.title: Cursor connector uses public Cloudflare quick tunnel
findings.evidence: Cursor connector uses Cloudflare quick tunnel for localhost exposure.
findings.impact: Public URL increases attack surface; token exposure could allow remote access to local daemon.
acceptance_criteria: Document when/why tunnel is used.
Bind tunnel to cryptographically random token with short TTL.
Add UI indicator and one-click revocation.

findings.title: CI/CD has broad secrets and can ship malicious release
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml signs and notarizes using GitHub secrets.
findings.impact: Users install trojanized update; worst-case full user compromise.
acceptance_criteria: Require two-person rule for release workflow.
Use OIDC to fetch short-lived signing certs where possible.
Publish reproducible-build instructions and verification.

findings.title: Firestore rules drift risk
findings.evidence: Rules live in firestore.rules; deployment manual/semi-automated; no CI drift test.
findings.impact: Production rules may diverge from repo, weakening tenant isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Add CI step comparing deployed rules to repo.
Add property-based tests for rule paths.

findings.title: Rate limiting missing from callable surface
findings.evidence: No global rate-limit middleware; only resilience helpers for Stripe/Firestore.
findings.impact: Abuse, enumeration, or cost attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Add per-UID rate limiting for expensive callables.
Add App Check + IP-based anomaly alerting.

findings.title: Data deletion cascade incomplete
findings.evidence: functions/src/callables/dataDeletion.ts exists; prior audit M-013 noted incomplete cascade.
findings.impact: User data may remain in Firestore/Storage/backup after deletion request.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end test proving deletion of all user documents and Storage blobs.
Verify local deletion path.

findings.title: Android iroh secret key caching
findings.evidence: Prior audit M-006 noted iroh secret key may be cached in shared preferences.
findings.impact: Key extraction from rooted or backup-exposed devices.
acceptance_criteria: Store iroh secret key in Android Keystore.
Add migration from shared prefs.

findings.title: Cloud Vault AAD partial
findings.evidence: Prior audit M-007 noted AAD coverage incomplete across envelope variants.
findings.impact: Possible substitution or malleability of sealed payloads.
acceptance_criteria: Audit every seal/open call site for AAD binding to sender, recipient, scope.
Add tests that reject tampered AAD.

findings.title: session_logs callable/rule validation gaps
findings.evidence: Prior audit M-018 noted validation gaps in session_logs write path.
findings.impact: Malformed or oversized logs could break sync or leak across documents.
acceptance_criteria: Strict schema validation for session_logs writes.
Size/depth limits enforced.

findings.title: Log parser memory exhaustion / zip bomb
findings.evidence: Parsers load entire files; no size/depth caps visible.
findings.impact: DoS via malicious log file.
acceptance_criteria: Max file size per parser.
Max nested depth for JSON/XML.
Streaming parse where possible.

findings.title: Exported data may contain more than expected
findings.evidence: Prior audit M-014 noted dataExport could include derived or cached fields.
findings.impact: User receives more data than expected; regulatory concern.
acceptance_criteria: Audit dataExport fields against privacy policy.

findings.title: Push notification payload may leak UID
findings.evidence: Prior audit M-023 noted agentNotifications.ts leaked UIDs.
findings.impact: FCM payload could deanonymize user or link devices.
acceptance_criteria: Notification body contains no UIDs, names, or provider IDs.

findings.title: Phone HID capability token binding weak
findings.evidence: Prior audit M-028 noted HID actions need stronger capability-token binding to device/session.
findings.impact: Cross-pairing or stolen token could allow unauthorized remote input.
acceptance_criteria: Bind each HID capability grant to a specific session/device key.
Verify token before every action.

findings.title: Free-form crash context could leak content
findings.evidence: Sentry/Crashlytics scrubbers exist but cannot catch all free-form error messages.
findings.impact: Agent log fragments or paths may appear in crash reports.
acceptance_criteria: Audit all throw sites for user content.
Add before-send hook tests with synthetic sensitive data.

findings.title: Local daemon auth token rotation undefined
findings.evidence: Single auth token stored in defaults/keychain; no documented rotation on reinstall/update.
findings.impact: Long-lived secret; compromise of one client can persist.
acceptance_criteria: Document rotation policy.
Rotate on major updates or on demand.
